sentence: This project studies how narcotics change the activity of endogenous retroviruses in human microglia cells during HIV latency.
This project tries to prevent blindness by using CRISPR-Cas9 to knock out a key transcription factor in photoreceptors.
This project builds nanoparticles that carry an immune signaling protein into tumors to switch on immune cells that fight cancer.
This project builds a system of sensors and data processing that older adults can use to reveal changes in cognition and mobility.
This project tests how anxiety sensitivity and intolerance of uncertainty may link chronic pain to suicidal thoughts and behavior.
This project builds computer methods that predict how tightly drug molecules bind to proteins, to help with drug discovery.
This project studies how the machines in cells read the epigenome and respond to incoming signals.
This project studies how a receptor called GPR6 drives therapy resistance in prostate cancer and tests antibodies that block it.
This project tests whether a kinase called PKCa helps explain racial disparities seen in prostate cancer.
This project tries to find the target proteins through which adding and removing carbohydrates affects developing animals.
This project tests whether overdose risk prediction tools combined with simple nudges in the electronic health record change how clinicians prescribe opioids.
This project studies which clinical and social factors speed up aging-related decline in older survivors of early-stage lung cancer.
This project studies how lipid kinases choose their substrates and how blocking one of them could disrupt SARS-CoV-2 replication in cells.
This project builds lineage tracing methods to find out how human natural killer cells arise from progenitor cells.
This project searches exome sequencing data for tandem repeat changes that may cause Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how chemical injury harms the cornea and how it repairs, using gene knockout systems and proteomic approaches.
This project tests whether a fully remote overdose prevention education program lowers overdose rates among people who use stimulants or opioids.
This project studies how parenting, emotion and brain responses relate to substance use in adolescents, using fMRI and momentary assessment.
This project tests whether delivering antibody-coated iron nanocarriers through an artery, together with electroporation, can treat liver cancer.
This project develops gene editing therapies and biodegradable delivery vehicles to treat cystic fibrosis.
